title: agent: drift details besides Codex's proxied one are shown in English in every language
head: a6df7cec93739ce4aa70d6f019da645497ca95b1
testCommands: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 go build -tags nogui ./...
testsAdded: internal/agent/drift_notice_test.go: TestDriftDetailsAreTranslated pins the English sentence and the zh/ja renderings of all 13 drift details (replaced, replaced-by-default, three bypassed, five unreachable, three wiringOff) and holds each to being a registered notice
unverifiedBoundaries: The drift details an agent's own Check builds outside wiringOff (per-agent sentences in agents.go, codex.go, kimi.go, air.go, ...) and a native app's own Detail are still plain English; converting them needs one notice per sentence in each agent file and was not attempted here
Codex's proxied detail (codexProxiedDetail in internal/agent/codex_proxy.go) is still a plain string in this base, though issue #2867 assumes it is already a notice; it is unchanged by this branch
No real GUI was opened: tNotice's behaviour is covered indirectly (its NOTICES/translation tables are the ones the Go test reads)
